newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 21 issues for bond insurance
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 21 issues for bond insurance

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp said it has qualified for bond insurance the following municipal 21 issues scheduled for competitive sale today.
--Southside School District No.3, Ark., $1.120 million refunding bonds.
--Signal Hill, Calif., $10 million of certificates of participation.
--Colorado $13.9 million of certificates of participation.
--Deep River, Conn., $4.8 million general obligation bonds.
--Panorama Community School District, Iowa, $5.495 million school GOs.
--Kansas State Development Finance $40 million of revenue bonds.
--Kansas State Development Finance $9.8 million of notes.
--Auburn, Mass., $2.510 million GOs.
--Hancock Public Schools, Mich., $8.485 million GOs.
--Hibbing ISD #701, Minn., $2.2 million GO school building bonds.
--Mercer County, N.J., $4.8 million school bonds.
--Mercer County, N.J., $1.4 million of school bonds.
--$100 million of the New Jersey Transportation Fund's $713 million offerings.
--South River, N.J., $3.475 million improvement GOs.
--Averill Park CSD, N.Y., $12.5 million school district bonds.
--Irvington, N.Y., $1.239 million improvement bonds.
--Malverne, N.Y., $1.497 million GOs.
--Metro, Ore., $28.8 million GOs.
--Henrico County Ind. Development, Va., $28.765 million lease revenue bonds.
--Ocean City, N.J., Board of Education $2.420 million.
--West Palm Beach, Fla., $15 million of water and sewer bonds.
--U.S. Municipal Desk, 212-859-1650
